versions.name: The Tropical
versions.text: {{STYLE:tropical|Starwalker}}. {{KW:MAGIC}}: If you have 4+ unique rarities in your dustpile, gain {{KW:HASTE}} and {{KW:TAUNT}}. If you have 6+, {{KW:ERASE}} them to gain {{STATS:+1|+1}} and {{KW:DODGE}}.
versions.note: Not listed in Version History for this card; assumed Beta 123.0 (in effect when the tracker saw it, 2026-11-01).
